verdict.rationale: Adyen documents the settlement side: merchants can choose when and in which currency to settle, configure multiple payout currencies per merchant account, and receive local or cross-border (SWIFT) payouts. The evidence never explicitly says shoppers are charged in their local currency; it only covers local payment methods and checkout language localization. Nothing describes how FX conversion is handled, what rates or fees apply, or how conversions are reported. Missing for 10: explicit docs on processing in shoppers' local currencies, transparent FX rates/fees/markup disclosure, FX conversion reporting, independent corroboration of the multi-currency flow.
